newsitem.title: INDIA: India appoints ombudsman for business approvals.
newsitem.headline: India appoints ombudsman for business approvals.

text.p: India has appointed a watchdog who will attend to complaints regarding delays in approval of business projects, the Industry Ministry said on Wednesday.
The ministry said in a statement that this was part of a drive to boost transparency and objectivity in the promotion of private investment.

"As an effective measure in this direction, government has constituted a business ombudsperson to handle complaints or inordinate delays in the matter of clearance of projects/approvals etc," the statement said.

It named A.V. Singh, additional secretary in the Industry Ministry, as the designated ombudsman to handle complaints and facilitate disposal of applications in close coordination with other federal and state government departments.
The Foreign Investment Promotion Board (FIPB) falls under the Industry Ministry.
